title: Small talk first
text: Answer a few casual questions. Your words will come back to haunt someone.

scene.phone: What did you have for breakfast?

title: Shredded into tiles
text: All the small talk is shredded into word tiles and shared out among the other players.

title: Nail the interview
text: Answer interview questions using only the word tiles you salvaged. Build your answer on your phone.

title: Get hired
text: Everyone votes on the answers. The highest salary at the end gets the job.
